skillSays: Use existing shadcn components before writing custom markup, and compose them (Card with Header, Title, Description, Content, Footer; Table, Badge, Avatar, Alert).
Use built-in variants and semantic tokens (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground), never raw colours; className is for layout only.
Forms are FieldGroup plus Field, with FieldLabel, FieldDescription and FieldError; validation is data-invalid on the Field and aria-invalid on the control.
Use gap utilities instead of space-x/space-y, Separator instead of hr, Badge instead of styled spans, ToggleGroup for 2-5 options, Alert for callouts.
Theme by editing OKLCH CSS variables (--primary, --radius, --border, --ring) and the .dark class, never per-component dark: overrides.

changes: Reproduced shadcn's neutral OKLCH tokens, 0.625rem radius and Geist font, and remapped only --primary and --ring to Tidewater teal.
Composed the schedule preview from Card plus Table, Avatar with fallback and Badge variants instead of a custom styled list.
Feature section uses full Card composition (CardHeader with title and description, CardContent) and the hero announcement is a Badge, not a custom pill.
Monthly/Yearly switch is a single-select ToggleGroup, as the skill prescribes for 2-5 options, rather than looped buttons with manual active state.

Plan cards are Cards with CardHeader, CardAction (Most popular Badge), CardContent and CardFooter; the separator is a Separator, and the featured plan relies on Badge plus the default Button variant, with no colour overrides.
Savings label is a secondary Badge.
Form uses FieldGroup and Field with FieldLabel, FieldDescription and FieldError; invalid state is data-invalid on the Field plus aria-invalid on the Input.
Clinic size uses the native-select pattern, the terms control is a Checkbox in a horizontal Field, and the success message is an Alert.
Wrapped in a Card with CardHeader and CardContent; the password reveal button is a ghost Button.
